posts.body:
A classic, fonts tend to look too close together... The problem would be small if they
NOT
made the font unintelligible.
So taking advantage of the fact that I'm awake in the middle of the night (don't do it, it's not healthy) I'm here for answers.
What ways do I have to fix the font to a decent MS Gothic/Mincho (I think that's what they were called)?

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
2k3 render the font in a clear pixilated way so perhaps your choices of fonts are limited.
Those fonts with round corners or 'fat' fonts will look bad at such small size.
